method: 8x8..32x40 Saturn pieces coloured with bank palette slot 12, greyscale; PC image box-reduced by 2, cyan (0,255,255) = clear; masked normalised cross-correlation of the piece inside each PC image (>=90% of the piece covered by opaque PC pixels). Tier content needs score >= 0.90 and a 0.05 margin.
scope: Content pairing of decoded Saturn unit pieces (UNIT04 slot 0 image set) with PC SAKURA2/UNIT SPR; scores only, no pixels.

summary.no-counterpart: all other Saturn pieces and all 291 PC files
summary.reason: Saturn images are body parts (torso, arms, legs of a Koubu), not whole frames; the layout tables that assemble them were not found, so a piece only matches part of a PC frame and scores stay below the 0.90 tier.
